name: ROI token unprotected transferOwnership
summary: ROIToken's transferOwnership() has no onlyOwner check, so anyone can become owner. The attacker took ownership, used the owner's fee and reward-exclusion setters to set a 99% reflection fee, excluded every holder but the BUSD/ROI pair, flash-swapped ROI out of the pair and back so the fee was charged to the pair, then re-included itself to keep the inflated reflected balance and sold it for the pair's BUSD.
notes: Before the anchor several unrelated accounts took ownership through the same function (0x09240e14, 0x536a0ebf, 0xa8a4342b, 0x72a6c164); 0x231aadf4 kept it from 0x9905bb95 (June 2022), zeroed fees, toggled the pair's reward exclusion and sold 540 ROI for 6 BUSD (0x51fad91f). None took more than dust from the pair, so the anchor is the first exploit; ownership changes and fee settings are not resets.
Campaign: a repeat by the same attacker (0x1c0be5ed) and two copycats that again took ownership (0xaec77ecd, 0x7e8f359c). ROI is not depleted from the pair, so the loss is its BUSD outflow.
